moderation_logs_target_check.name: moderation_logs_target_check
moderation_logs_target_check.value: (("moderation_logs"."post_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("moderation_logs"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

reports_target_check.name: reports_target_check
reports_target_check.value: (("reports"."post_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("reports"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1

reports_resolution_check.name: reports_resolution_check
reports_resolution_check.value:
("reports"."status" = 'pending' AND "reports"."resolved_by" IS NULL AND "reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("reports"."status" <> 'pending' AND "reports"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

users_verified_check.name: users_verified_check
users_verified_check.value:
("users"."is_verified" = false AND "users"."university_id" IS NULL AND "users"."university_email" IS NULL)
        OR ("users"."is_verified" = true AND "users"."university_id" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."university_email" IS NOT NULL)
